name: Create Charlotte's Web Reading Comprehension Guide Flipchart
description:
A 3rd grade language arts teacher needs a reading comprehension guide for Charlotte's Web by E.B. White. Create a 4-page flipchart:

Page 1 — Title page: 'Charlotte's Web' as the main title, 'By E.B. White' as subtitle, and a line for 'Name: ___________'.

Page 2 — Comprehension questions: Title 'Comprehension Questions' with at least 3 numbered questions about the story (you may make up appropriate comprehension questions about characters, plot, or setting).

Page 3 — Character analysis: Title 'Character Analysis' with a labeled rectangle box for each of the three main characters: Wilbur, Charlotte, and Fern. Each box should have the character's name visible as text.

Page 4 — Theme and message: Title 'Theme and Message' with text prompts asking students about the book's theme and what lesson the author conveys.

Login as ga / password123. Save the completed flipchart as /home/ga/Documents/Flipcharts/charlottes_web_guide.flipchart
